newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares close flat on pre-election caution.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares close flat on pre-election caution.

text.p: * New Zealand shares finish little changed
* Big portfolio sale pre-opening main action
* Big line in Brierley crossed
Price movements at close.
LAST CHG
330 nil * NZSC cap index -7.65 at 4,461.31
368 +3 * Volume NZ$51 million. Futures 1125, -9
688 -1 * Other movers - +5, -10
New Zealand shares closed just a touch lower on Friday, with brokers reporting quiet trading after a big portfolio sale pre-opening.
The NZSE-40 capital index finished off 0.72 at 2,238.88 on turnover of NZ$51 million.
Tim Preston of brokers ANZ Securities said an $18.5 million portfolio sale before the opening counted for some 40 percent of turnover.
"Take out that portfolio and the crossing of 3.6 million Brierley shares by (brokers) Ord Minnett, and trading was fairly scratchy," Preston said.
Brierley Investments was level at $1.44 in trade post-close after being up one at $1.45 on the close.
Preston said buyers were becoming cautious ahead of the election, now only three weeks away on October 12.
"There will be flurries of interest, but the trend to the election will be tentative.
"There has been huge interest in the New Zealand dollar, and exporters must be starting to hurt. And the Ceramco result shows there is room for disappointment if you get it wrong," Preston said.
Ceramco Corp on Thursday said it expected a net loss of NZ$1.6 million for the half year to September and break even for the full year. It ended down 10 at $1.26.

Preston said a change of government was still on the cards and there was the chance the business community, which was expecting a continuation of conservative governments, might be disappointed. -- Vernon Small 64 4 4714 278
